newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY-Phila. Fed alters monthly survey release.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY-Phila. Fed alters monthly survey release.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia on Tuesday said it was altering the procedure for release of its monthly Business Outlook Survey (BOS).
Starting with the release of its February report on Thursday, the Fed bank said it will issue the BOS to members of the press no earlier than 1000 EST/GMT 1500.
Reuters will make the report available to subscribers as soon as it receives the data.

Previously, news services had received the report at around 0930 EST/1430 GMT for release to subscribers at precisely 1000 EST/1500 GMT. Erroneous releases by some news services prior to the 1000 EST/1500 GMT release time resulted in the Fed bank's change of policy.

Additionally, the Fed bank said teleconferences with a Philadelphia Federal Reserve economist will start at about 1010 EST/1510 GMT instead of 1003 EST/1503 GMT to provide reporters ample time to read through the survey. These teleconferences are carried live on Reuters Financial Television.
